name: CineTube – Movie Streaming Platform
description: CineTube is a full-stack movie streaming platform where users can explore movies and add review, rating and like comments, subscribe to plans, and enjoy premium content. It includes authentication, subscription management, role-based dashboards, and analytics for admins. Users can browse categorized movies, view details, and manage subscriptions seamlessly.
projectLore: I built CineTube to simulate a real-world OTT platform experience. The goal was to combine subscription systems, media management, and user analytics into one scalable application. In future updates, I plan to add video streaming optimization, watch history tracking, personalized recommendations, and payment gateway improvements.
challenge: The biggest challenge was implementing subscription logic with proper access control. Ensuring only subscribed users could access premium content while maintaining secure authentication and handling Prisma relations for users, subscriptions, and media required careful backend design.

name: SkillBridge – Tutor Booking Platform
description: SkillBridge is a full-stack tutor booking platform where students can discover tutors, view profiles, check availability, and book sessions. It includes authentication, role-based dashboards, and a structured booking system with real-time availability handling.
projectLore: I built SkillBridge to simulate a real-world service marketplace. The goal was to design a scalable booking system with proper availability management, role-based access control, and clean architecture. In future updates, I plan to add payment integration, real-time notifications, and advanced tutor recommendations.
challenge: The biggest challenge was implementing the availability and booking system without double-booking issues. Managing relational data between users, tutor profiles, and availability slots while ensuring secure authentication and proper role-based routing required careful backend and middleware design.
